players.product: Tecochill hybrid-drive (natural-gas / electric) dual power source chillers (air-cooled, water-cooled and DTx) and InVerde power-generation modules for data-center cooling

quarterly_data.signal: Tecogen's 8-K: customer Cloudsmart, Inc., a Tier 3, SOC 2 cloud and AI data center in Connecticut, has been generating its own power for a few months with Tecogen's InVerde cogeneration system; Cloudsmart CEO Robyn Sullivan said it cut electric bills substantially and the unit has run reliably. Tecogen CEO Abinand Rangesh: such real-world proof points are essential to convert the company's data center pipeline to orders.
